questions.question: How many total child victims were reported in California?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('hhs_acf_child_victims_by_age.csv')
df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
result = int(df.loc[df['State'] == 'California', 'Total Victims'].values[0])

questions.question: Which state had the highest rate of child maltreatment victims under age 1 per 1,000 children?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('hhs_acf_child_victims_by_age.csv')
df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
states_df = df[~df['State'].isin(['National', 'Reporting States'])]
result = states_df.sort_values(by='<1 Rate per 1,000 Children', ascending=False).iloc[0]['State']

questions.question: How many states had more than 20,000 total child victims, excluding national totals and summary rows?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('hhs_acf_child_victims_by_age.csv')
df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
states_df = df[~df['State'].isin(['National', 'Reporting States'])]
result = int((states_df['Total Victims'] > 20000).sum())

questions.question: Did Texas have more total child victims than New York?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('hhs_acf_child_victims_by_age.csv')
df.columns = [c.strip() for c in df.columns]
tx_total = df.loc[df['State'] == 'Texas', 'Total Victims'].values[0]
ny_total = df.loc[df['State'] == 'New York', 'Total Victims'].values[0]
result = 'yes' if tx_total > ny_total else 'no'
